- [permanent] User communicates in Chinese (Simplified) and expects responses in Chinese.
- [durable] On 2026-08-30, five image-generation open-source repos were shallow-cloned into research/image_generation_20260830/: CompVis/stable-diffusion, huggingface/diffusers, AUTOMATIC1111/stable-diffusion-webui, Comfy-Org/ComfyUI, and lllyasviel/Fooocus.
- [durable] To resolve a VFS file-quota overflow (107,297 > 100,000 limit) in /root/GitHubResearch_Agent, webui/node_modules and research/llm_finetuning_20260811/ were deleted; webui dependencies would need `bun install` to be rebuilt.

- [correction] The five RAG repos from the /rere report (infiniflow/ragflow, HKUDS/LightRAG, NirDiamant/RAG_Techniques, pathwaycom/llm-app, Andrew-Jang/RAGHub) are actually cloned locally in the per-user VFS under user 8546fe5d881f77cf392e95bc/projects/; the earlier "they don't exist" claim was wrong because the search only covered the old cache dirs at shallow depth.
- [durable] Local GitHub repo caches use two layouts: shared cache at `.nanobot/repositories/` and per-user isolated VFS at `.nanobot/vfs/tenants/<tenant>/users/<user_id>/projects/<owner>/<repo>/source`; shallow-depth scans of the old dirs can miss VFS content.
- [durable] The agent runs under a `restrict_to_workspace` policy rooted at `/root/GitHubResearch_Agent`; shell access to paths outside it is hard-blocked by the safety guard (not a transient failure, no symlink/base64 workarounds).
- [durable] Repo cache deletion must go through the Repository Orchestrator approval-ID flow (requester confirms via `/approve-delete <approval_id>`); never use filesystem/shell deletion tools for repo caches, and require `owner/repo`.
- [ephemeral] The `research/repositories/` directory (image-generation repos) was removed/migrated during this session.
